name: zgeometry_model_clip_patch
description: zGeometry_Model::ClipPatch creates a clip polygon for an outline, gathers camera/grid nodes, processes inside and clipping nodes, and records generated node/DI pairs in the clip-patch output.
known_limits: The smoke target covers null input and the valid empty camera/grid-cell path that allocates then removes an empty partition; node output and generated DI paths are covered through accepted ProcessNodePolygonSetXY and ProcessClipPatchNode targets and deferred to the coherent clip-patch cluster pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46b1f0 validates null input rejection, clip polygon creation, output partition growth, node pair allocation, camera-node retrieval, camera and feature-grid node scans, snap/bounds update loop, Weiler state initialization, inside-node processing, clip-node processing with pair compaction, rotated point copy on generated output, empty/failure partition rollback, clip polygon finalization, temporary candidate-array frees, and return count.
The native ClipPatch smoke verifies null input returns -1 and a valid empty camera/grid-cell call returns 0 after rolling back the temporary partition while leaving the output empty.
